description: This file defines request handlers for wizard-related operations in a gateway server, including starting, progressing, canceling, and checking the status of wizard sessions.

classes.name: WizardSession
classes.description: Represents a wizard session with methods to get status, answer questions, and cancel.

methods.name: readWizardStatus
methods.description: Reads the current status and error state of a wizard session.

methods.name: findWizardSessionOrRespond
methods.description: Finds a wizard session by ID or responds with an error if not found.
